answer: I would anchor trust in Uniswap LP position age. With a liquidity position open for six months, a single nebula check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that a liquidity position open for six months — so privacy survives, and the ledge is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the wharf of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
